note: Raster is pre-warped to true Web Mercator (not Plate Carree). Place by projecting [lon0,lat1] (top-left) and [lon1,lat0] (bottom-right) through the live d3 projection and stretching the image to exactly fill that rectangle -- the two-point affine placement is geometrically exact because the raster is pixel-square in raw Mercator units.
